decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir sits squarely within the firm's long-standing hydraulic steel engineering know-how, so the firm can interpret field results and refine it readily, and it should stay in the portfolio.

The energy management system builds on the firm's automation software and its strategic push toward networked infrastructure and energy recovery, and in-house R&D plus university cooperation give it the knowledge to develop the product further despite its more digital, less proven nature.

The overflow flap gate is a core mechanical product close to the established offer and has its own dedicated web page, which signals commitment and strong absorptive fit, so it is very likely to be kept.
